recipe: From repository root: pnpm --dir tools/spikes/voice-audio run package:va3b:rnnoise. Copies exact pinned sync glue without transformation; only replaces the diagnostic heading of previously verified notices. Refuses to overwrite existing artifacts. Production builds serve committed public files without loading spike code or dependencies. Then run finalize:va3b:rnnoise to preserve the initial manifest and record production processor/engine/fixed-DSP hashes. Production source is committed and packaged unchanged; no spike dependency is shipped.
